question.text: Ram is visiting a friend. Ram knows that his friend has 2 children and 1 of them is a boy. Assuming that a child is equally likely to be a boy or a girl, then the probability that the other child is a girl, is

solution.text:
Total sample space $=\left\{B_{1} B_{2}, B_{1} G_{1}, G_{1} B_{2}\right\}$
Favourable ways $=\left\{B_{1} G_{1}, G_{1} B_{2}\right\}$
$\therefore$ Required probability $=\frac{2}{3}$
